categories.main_business_segments: Wuxi JinYang New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of battery precision structural parts and materials. Its main products include battery packaging shells, safety valves, and nickel-based conductor materials, serving the lithium battery manufacturing industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced mold design and manufacturing processes, vacuum melting and casting for nickel ingots, six-roll hydraulic AGC rolling mills for nickel strip precision, and computer-aided blade matching for cutting. It has developed core technologies such as lithium battery triple safety protection structural parts, low-resistance high-current lithium battery safety valves, and high-capacity battery packaging shells, supported by 43 invention patents and 137 utility model patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include globally renowned lithium battery manufacturers such as LG Energy Solution, Panasonic, Samsung SDI, BYD, CATL, EVE Energy, Lishen Battery, BAK Battery, and Hengdian Group Dongci. The end markets served are electric vehicles, electric light vehicles, electric tools, consumer electronics, and new energy storage systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with production bases in Wuxi, Hubei, Xiamen, and Wuhan. Its sales are predominantly domestic (over 97%), with a small portion of exports accounting for about 2.58%.
categories.supply_chain_position: JinYang operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, manufacturing critical battery structural components and conductor materials that are essential for battery assembly and performance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in high-performance battery structural parts, expanding production capacity, and enhancing automation. R&D priorities include developing large-capacity, no-tab round shells, high-performance battery caps, vacuum refining of nickel ingots, precision rolling and cutting of nickel strips, and composite electrode sheet preparation. It collaborates with universities and research institutes and maintains a customer-driven R&D model.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of battery precision structural parts and nickel-based conductor materials to lithium battery manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model with contract-based orders and invoicing upon delivery and reconciliation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JinYang is a leading domestic manufacturer in the lithium battery precision structural parts sector, recognized for its technological strength and scale. It competes with other major suppliers serving top-tier battery manufacturers and maintains stable, long-term partnerships due to high entry barriers and certification cycles in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, a 22.96% increase year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.26 million, slightly down by 8.07%. The company has shown steady growth in production scale and sales volume, especially in cylindrical and prismatic battery structural parts, supported by ongoing capacity expansions and new product launches.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JinYang emphasizes high precision, high consistency, and high safety in its battery structural parts and materials. Its products meet stringent technical standards required by leading battery manufacturers, offering superior dimensional accuracy, safety valve performance, and conductor material quality. The company’s integrated product system covering shells, safety valves, and nickel-based materials provides customers with comprehensive solutions and supply chain reliability.
